law: Do not claim Runtime/Actions can re-execute arbitrary raw-byte analyses from acceptance metadata alone. Reuse deterministic derived evidence in the repository when sufficient. If a future research judgment genuinely requires raw bytes that are not durably available, surface an explicit artifact/data availability gate rather than looping implementation.
current_resolution: The raw accepted ZIP was available to the active Director session and was used once to materialize the authorized deterministic non-economic triage result. No recapture and no economic outcome occurred.
